title: T-24 part 1, two players: a merged MEMBER books a FURNITURE and a FOOD delivery for a partner's shop; the booking is created ONLY on the game that runs the shop (once, even when resent), nothing is charged at booking, the goods arrive there when the slot passes; then, with the owner away, the STAND-IN books for the owner's shop and the booking goes home with the owner. Ends dissolved, NO save
preconditions: Fixture save1 (host melaus, client Client1). Build with T-24 part 1 deployed on BOTH machines. HOST = OWNER for legs 1-3 (the client's mergestatus keys[0] is a host building flipped on the client); CLIENT = OWNER for leg 5 (the host's mergestatus keys[0], which the host simulates while the client is away). Steps 13-22 check every premise and refuse on a pre-existing delivery for either shop. The rig draws no dialog: `mergerfurniture` / `mergerfood` send the leg the dialogs send, `servicelists` reads both lists with an own/stand-in tag, `pickercheck` runs the destination picker's filter. The leg 'owner offline and nobody standing in' has NO fixture here: a dropped owner always gets the host as stand-in. NOTHING is saved.
